name: Ryze
bio: Ryze is the founder and lead developer of RxN Developing, an independent team focused on creating software, automation systems, custom tools, and websites.
He primarily works on the design, programming, and development of solutions for businesses, video games, online communities, Windows applications, and digital systems.

name: Ninja
bio: Ninja is a developer and collaborator at RxN Developing. He contributes to the team’s projects by supporting software and website development, testing, design, and the improvement of technical solutions.
He works alongside Ryze to transform ideas into concrete, organized, and functional projects across software, automation, gaming, and the web.
